# Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks

**Authors:** Michael Tschannen, Olivier Bachem, Mario Lucic  
**Year:** 2014  
**Journal:** IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1511.06434](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1511.06434)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.06434](https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.06434)

**Keywords:** dcgan, gan, image generation

## Abstract

We introduce a class of CNNs called deep convolutional generative adversarial networks whose architecture is a stable version of GAN.
